data.name: Sacchidanand
data.gender_notes: Sacchidanand is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sacchidanand is a name of God, meaning 'He who is the embodiment of truth, consciousness, and bliss'. It is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'sacchid' (truth) and 'anand' (bliss). This name signifies the eternal, unchanging nature of the divine, and evokes feelings of peace, purity, and happiness. The name Sacchidanand carries the meaning “Truthful, Pure, Blissful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sacchidanand usually hope their child will grow to embody truthful, pure, blissful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sacchidanand is a powerful spiritual name, representing the ultimate reality and divine consciousness. It is often used in meditation and mantra practices, and can help to deepen one's connection to the divine and bring a sense of inner peace and joy.
data.etymology: Sacchidanand belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truthful, Pure, Blissful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sacchidanand total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
